scenes.narration: Is Lionel Messi the greatest of all time?

scenes.main_point: Count up to six and show one Golden Shoe cut-out six times in an even grid

scenes.narration: Four hundred and seventy-four La Liga goals, a record, and seventy-three in a single season.

scenes.visual_objective: Draw Barcelona goals per season, count up the 474 La Liga goals and mark the 73 of 2011-12

scenes.visual_objective: Show a real photograph of the 2022 World Cup trophy being kissed in an Argentina shirt, with 2022 in large type and an Argentina shirt cut-out

scenes.visual_objective: Compare key passes per 90 in two sampled seasons with animated bars and the sample caveat
